gpt-6-astra._note: OpenRouter model and endpoint catalogs re-verified 2026-09-22: https://openrouter.ai/api/v1/models/openai/gpt-6-astra/endpoints; canonical slug openai/gpt-6-astra-20260903. Reasoning is mandatory, with efforts max, xhigh, high, medium and low, and the default is medium. Holds the openai_top seat for the async text and visual councils. No effort pin: the gateway default is medium. The separate Codex apex tier pins high effort.
gpt-6-astra._pricing_note: Cache write is $12.50 per 1M tokens. Above 272000 input tokens, input is $20, output is $75, cached input is $2 and cache write is $25 per 1M tokens. Verified 2026-09-22 against the OpenRouter model catalog.

gpt-6-sol._note: Replaces gpt-5.6-sol and gpt-5.6-terra: GPT-6 has no Terra, so every former Terra role resolves here. Endpoints verified 2026-09-22 against the OpenRouter catalog: OpenAI and Amazon Bedrock; canonical slug openai/gpt-6-sol-20260922. The serving_providers pin keeps every request on the OpenAI host. Reasoning is optional, with efforts none, low, medium, high, xhigh and max, and the default is medium. This entry pins no effort; gpt-6-sol-low is the pinned-LOW alias. Rejects temperature. Chat Completions allows function calling only at reasoning_effort none, and the gateway sends no tools. Knowledge cutoff 2026-04-20. The capability scores are estimates copied from gpt-5.6-sol.
gpt-6-sol._pricing_note: Cache write is $2.50 per 1M tokens. Above 272000 input tokens, input is $4, output is $15, cached input is $0.40 and cache write is $5 per 1M tokens. Verified 2026-09-22 against the OpenRouter model catalog.

gpt-6-sol-low._note: Same SKU as gpt-6-sol, pinned to LOW reasoning effort. No model_roles entry resolves here: the entry exists by owner instruction and is reachable only by naming this key. The gateway emits the pin as the top-level reasoning_effort field. Rejects temperature. Verified 2026-09-22 against the OpenRouter model catalog.
gpt-6-sol-low._pricing_note: Cache write is $2.50 per 1M tokens. Above 272000 input tokens, input is $4, output is $15, cached input is $0.40 and cache write is $5 per 1M tokens. Verified 2026-09-22 against the OpenRouter model catalog.

gpt-6-luna._note: Replaces gpt-5.6-luna. Canonical slug openai/gpt-6-luna-20260922; served by OpenAI and Amazon Bedrock, verified 2026-09-22 against the OpenRouter catalog. Reasoning efforts match gpt-6-sol, the default is medium, and this entry pins none. Rejects temperature. Chat Completions allows function calling only at reasoning_effort none, and the gateway sends no tools. Knowledge cutoff 2026-05-18. No model_roles entry resolves here: the entry exists by owner instruction. The capability scores are estimates copied from gpt-5.6-luna.
gpt-6-luna._pricing_note: Cache write is $0.125 per 1M tokens. Above 272000 input tokens, input is $0.20, output is $0.75, cached input is $0.02 and cache write is $0.25 per 1M tokens. Verified 2026-09-22 against the OpenRouter model catalog.

gpt-image-2.5-sunburst._note: Replaces gpt-image-2, which called the fused SKU openai/gpt-5.4-image-2. Verified 2026-09-22 against /api/v1/models?output_modalities=image and the model's endpoints; canonical slug openai/gpt-image-2.5-sunburst-20260908. OpenAI serves it on chat completions. Input is text and image. Output is IMAGE ONLY with no text part, whereas the fused SKU returned image and text. No crux role or script names an image entry, and the text callers (call_model, call_gateway, the council seats and /chat) refuse it by type with NotATextModelError, because they return only the reply text: image generation has no crux caller. The entry exists by owner instruction. Reasoning is unsupported and temperature is supported. The capability scores are estimates copied from gpt-image-2.
gpt-image-2.5-sunburst._pricing_note: Image output is $30 per 1M tokens. Verified 2026-09-22 against the OpenRouter model catalog.

claude-fable-5.1._note: Fable 5.1 replaces Fable 5. OpenRouter id, context, output limit, pricing, reasoning efforts, and temperature omission verified 2026-09-03 against https://openrouter.ai/api/v1/models. Capability scores are inherited estimates, not Fable 5.1 measurements. Pins HIGH effort for anthropic_top, council_arbiter, and think_deep. The async text and visual councils and the sync arbiter resolve here.

claude-fable-5.1-medium._note: Fable 5.1 replaces Fable 5. OpenRouter id, context, output limit, pricing, reasoning efforts, and temperature omission verified 2026-09-03 against https://openrouter.ai/api/v1/models. Capability scores are inherited estimates, not Fable 5.1 measurements. Same API model as claude-fable-5.1, pinned to MEDIUM effort for the synchronous council_default seat.

claude-opus-5.5._note: OpenRouter model and endpoint catalogs verified 2026-09-22 against https://openrouter.ai/api/v1/models. Canonical slug anthropic/claude-opus-5.5-20260921. Reasoning is mandatory; efforts max/xhigh/high/medium/low, default high. Capability scores are copied from the claude-fable-5.1 entry; they are estimates, not Opus 5.5 measurements. Pins HIGH effort for release_docs. No claude-opus-5.5-medium entry exists — nothing reads it.

claude-opus-5._note: Successor to claude-opus-4-8; drop-in at identical economics ($5/$25 per 1M, cached $0.50), 1M context, 128K max output. Thinking is adaptive-only AND on by default (omitting `thinking` runs adaptive; disabling thinking is capped at effort<=high). Rejects the temperature param. Separate rate-limit bucket from the Opus 4.x pool. SPECS TO RE-VERIFY against a fresh anthropic-models-overview capture (pricing/context reused from Opus 4.8, which Opus 5 matches; release date intentionally omitted pending a dated source).

claude-sonnet-5._note: Replaces claude-sonnet-4-6. Effort-controlled (adaptive thinking; effort defaults to high on the Claude API + Claude Code) and REJECTS the temperature param — a behavior change from Sonnet 4.6, which accepted it (verified via platform docs 2026-07-09). $3/$15 base; introductory $2/$10 through 2026-08-31. max_output_tokens corrected to 64000 per research/sources/anthropic-models-overview (2026-06-12) verification.

gemini-3.1-pro-preview._pricing_note: TIERED: prompts >200k tokens are $4 in / $18 out. Base (<=200k) shown. -customtools endpoint variant available. Source: research/sources/gemini-api-pricing + gemini-3-1-pro-preview.

gemini-3-pro-image-preview._note: OpenRouter serves one Nano Banana Pro slug (google/gemini-3-pro-image-preview) for both generation and editing, so the former gemini-3-pro-image-preview-edit entry is folded in here (PB-0077). Its editing capabilities and per_edit cost are carried over verbatim.

gemini-3.5-flash._note: Frontier-class fast model; sub-agent/agentic-loop workhorse. Source: research/sources/gemini-3-5-flash + gemini-api-pricing.

jev-1.13._note: Structured decision model. Reachable ONLY through the gateway's Decisions route (POST /api/alpha/decisions), NOT through chat completions, so call_model/call_gateway cannot address it; the adapter that can is a development-only experiment and is not part of this distribution. Pinned to 1.13; the latest alias is not a valid route id. Named in no catalog/models.yml alias and in NO model_roles entry, so no agent and no council seat can reach it — crux/scripts/crux/council/council.py resolves seats through model_roles, which is the surface that matters for that claim. Entry read 2026-09-18 from https://openrouter.ai/typesafe/jev-1.13.

performance_tracking._comment: IMPROVEMENT 1: Dynamic adaptation based on actual performance, not static scores

metrics_tracked.success_rate: Per model, per task type success/failure
metrics_tracked.judge_agreement_rate: How often judges agree with human feedback
metrics_tracked.task_type_performance: Model performance breakdown by task classification

model_roles._comment: Single source of truth for default model selection. String roles return one model, list roles return a council.

_changelog: 2026-09-22 (GPT-6): Register gpt-6-sol (pinned to the OpenAI serving provider), gpt-6-sol-low (effort low), gpt-6-luna and gpt-image-2.5-sunburst from the live OpenRouter catalog. Move openai_chat, think_medium, council_default[0], council_code[0], vision and recursive_improve[0] to gpt-6-sol. GPT-6 has no Terra, and no role moves to gpt-6-luna. openai_chat, think_medium and the OpenAI members of council_default and council_code now pin the OpenAI host and lose Amazon Bedrock as a fallback. gpt-5.6-sol, gpt-5.6-sol-low, gpt-5.6-terra, gpt-5.6-luna and gpt-image-2 are REMOVED as a deliberate compatibility break; they are never aliased to any GPT-6 SKU. gpt-image-2.5-sunburst returns an image with no text part, where the fused gpt-5.4-image-2 SKU returned both. gpt-6-sol-low, gpt-6-luna and gpt-image-2.5-sunburst have no reader and exist by owner instruction. gpt-6-astra is re-verified and openai_top stays on it. No effort pin and no council weight changes. The registry version is held at 2.1.0 because this patch bumps no version. | 2026-09-22: Register anthropic/claude-opus-5.5 ($4/$20 per 1M, high effort, pinned to the Anthropic serving provider) and add the release_docs role, which resolves to it; tools/generate-public-docs.py reads release_docs instead of anthropic_top. anthropic_top, think_deep, council_arbiter, council_default and every council seat and weight are unchanged; no claude-opus-5.5-medium entry is added. | 2026-09-04: Register openai/gpt-6-astra from the live OpenRouter catalog and move openai_top to Astra for async text and visual councils. Preserve the synchronous Terra seat and the separate Sol/low-effort entries. | 2.1.0 (2026-09-03): Upgrade the Fable council seats and shared Fable roles to claude-fable-5.1. Preserve high/medium effort pins. Verify model metadata against the live OpenRouter catalog; cached input is $0.25 per 1M tokens. | 2.0.0 (2026-08-26): OpenRouter is the single inference gateway (PB-0077). providers collapses to one openrouter entry (https://openrouter.ai/api/v1, Authorization: Bearer). Every model's provider is openrouter and its api_string is the verbatim OpenRouter id, pinned as-is and never normalized; the bare registry keys are UNCHANGED, so model_roles and every downstream reference need no edit. gpt-5.6-sol / gpt-5.6-sol-low pricing corrected to $2/$10 per 1M against the OpenRouter catalog. gemini-3-pro-image-preview-edit is FOLDED INTO gemini-3-pro-image-preview (OpenRouter serves one Nano Banana Pro slug for generation and editing) and gpt-image-2 is re-pointed at the fused SKU openai/gpt-5.4-image-2 (no standalone gpt-image-2 slug exists). claude-haiku-4-5-20251001 keeps its bare key but addresses anthropic/claude-haiku-4.5. The three council seats (gpt-5.6-sol, claude-fable-5, gemini-3.1-pro-preview) carry serving_providers, the provider.only allowlist that keeps the seats on three distinct serving hosts. openai_endpoint is DELETED from every entry — the gateway is OpenAI-compatible chat-completions only, and reasoning effort now rides the top-level reasoning_effort field. The eight reader-less blocks (judge_hierarchy, council_configurations, fallback_chains, routing_rules, pipelines, playbook_model_affinity, quality_metrics, recursive_improvement) are DELETED: nothing read them, and re-pinning them under renamed ids would be silent drift. performance_tracking is retained. | 1.5.0 (2026-07-24): Renamed the Anthropic Opus seat claude-opus-4-8 -> claude-opus-5 (Opus 5 released as the drop-in successor; identical $5/$25 per 1M pricing, cached $0.50, 1M context, 128K output, adaptive-only thinking that is now on by default). Every Opus routing seat now points at claude-opus-5: model_roles anthropic_balanced/anthropic_council/code_review/reflect/recursive_improve, judge_hierarchy, council_configurations, routing_rules, fallback chains, and pipelines (complex_refactor/documentation/architecture_decision/creative_generation reviewers). claude-fable-5 remains the flagship tier above Opus, and the sonnet/haiku cost tiers are unchanged. Pricing/context were carried over from Opus 4.8 (which Opus 5 matches) and are flagged for re-verification against a fresh anthropic-models-overview capture. Flagship hierarchy UNCHANGED: claude-fable-5 stays anthropic_top/council_arbiter/think_deep (Opus 5 kept in-place at the balanced/council/review seats). claude-opus-4-8 is REMOVED from the registry entirely — a fallback-only entry plus a `refusal_fallback` mapping were prototyped and then deliberately dropped before release because NO code read them: shipping a declarative-only mapping would have read as a live safety net that did not exist. Anthropic's server-side `fallbacks: "default"` beta is the real mechanism; wiring it is tracked as a follow-on. | 1.4.0 (2026-07-09): GPT-5.6 Sol/Sol-low/Terra/Luna is now the active OpenAI baseline (per PB-0037/PB-0038). GPT-5.5 and GPT-5.5-pro active identifiers were INTENTIONALLY REMOVED as part of this baseline switch — a deliberate compatibility break; they are NEVER aliased to any GPT-5.6 SKU. Imported Gemini 3.5 Flash (new model) and corrected Gemini 3.1 Pro (Preview) metadata/pricing (context_window, max_output_tokens, tiered cost, _pricing_note) from the production line's research-verified corrections (research/sources/gemini-api-pricing, gemini-3-1-pro-preview, gemini-3-5-flash); gemini-2.5-pro and gemini-2.5-flash (text) are retired in favor of these two across judge_hierarchy, council_configurations, routing_rules, and fallback_chains. claude-opus-4-8 and claude-sonnet-5 cross-verified against research/sources/anthropic-models-overview (2026-06-12); claude-sonnet-5 max_output_tokens corrected to 64000. GPT-5.6 SKU (Sol/Sol-low/Terra/Luna) cached_input_per_1m pricing was OMITTED — no authoritative local source exists for GPT-5.6 cache pricing — and each carries a Pricing UNVERIFIED note pending confirmation. claude-fable-5 and claude-fable-5-medium remain ACTIVE (not disabled) as the Anthropic flagship tier above Opus 4.8. Image models untouched.
